# src/connector-ui/src/views

Layer **ui** · project `connector-ui` · UI components: 15, Views: 15

Project navigation: [connector-ui](../projects/connector-ui-f36e97198b9e.md)

## Overview 🤖

Contains Vue.js components for various views in the connector UI.

**Responsibilities.** Manages the UI components for different views in the connector application.

**Usage.** The router uses these views to render different parts of the connector UI.

Running needs the run permission. |

### ImportDefinitionEditView

_component_ · [ImportDefinitionEditView.vue](../../src/connector-ui/src/views/ImportDefinitionEditView.vue#L1)

/import-definitions/:id ("new" to create): editor for one import job. Basic fields, the writable-column allowlist, the node tree, a preview of the plan for a pasted sample, and run history. A new job can start from a matching export's suggestion (including a sample handed over via sessionStorage). "Run" stages the sample as a PendingReview run and opens the four-eyes review dialog. Without the edit permission a saved job opens read-only.

### SchemaView

_component_ · [SchemaView.vue](../../src/connector-ui/src/views/SchemaView.vue#L1)

Step 3, /export-schema: the legacy single export mapping editor. Pick a source table, then map columns, flattened relations, nested JSON groups and the JSON wrapper; preview the result, load or save presets, and save the mapping that /api/pipeline/run uses. Warns before leaving with unsaved changes. Without the edit permission the mapping and its preview are shown read-only, with no presets or save.
